title: Gauhati High Court quashes Assam activist’s NSA detention

ai.summary: The Gauhati High Court quashed the NSA detention of land rights activist Pranab Doley after 118 days, following his arrest in July 2026 for protesting a luxury hotel project near Kaziranga National Park.

facts.claim: The Gauhati High Court quashed the detention of land rights activist Pranab Doley under the National Security Act (NSA)
facts.quote: The Gauhati High Court on Friday (November 6, 2026) quashed the detention of land rights activist Pranab Doley under the National Security Act (NSA)

facts.claim: The order paved the way for the release of the 40-year-old after 118 days in custody
facts.quote: The order paved the way for the release of the 40-year-old after 118 days in custody.

facts.claim: Mr. Doley was arrested on July 12, 2026, days after participating in a protest against the luxury hotel project at Ingle Pathar
facts.quote: Mr. Doley, convenor of the Greater Kaziranga Land and Human Rights Protection Committee, was arrested on July 12, 2026, days after participating in a protest against the luxury hotel project at Ingle Pathar

facts.claim: The Assam government invoked the NSA against him on July 30, 2026, to keep him in custody
facts.quote: The Assam government invoked the NSA against him on July 30, 2026, to keep him in custody.

ai.background_note: The court quashed the NSA detention of Pranab Doley, who was arrested for protesting a luxury hotel project near Kaziranga National Park, after 118 days in custody.
